verdict.rationale: Channel3 is a SaaS product-data API that handles user identifiers and API traffic, so asking where that data is stored is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any region selection or data-residency control. Community remarks about the catalog being US-only concern product coverage, not where customer data is stored, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
